items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I want you to go back in the control room and balance us up the same way as you're doing Arthur.

ctx.x: You had gotten the check and it cleared and you went down to the studio with Dick Hyman and were making the arrangement.

Oh yeah, and so we set the date. So he came in the night before the date was set and I said, Oh yes, one more thing, I'd like for you to do, I said, now have a fifth of scotch and a fifth of gin up there, I said, now that isn't enough whiskey to make everybody high, it's just enough because the date's early in the morning, everybody'll feel good, you know. So anyway, he says, okay, Cozy, and he had it. So, I did the show and told the boys what time, nine o'clock at the studio that morning. All the guys and so,…
playback and then you go on back and do another one, you know, you get the balance and all.
